game.title: Star Wars Zero Company
game.blurb: Squad strategy game set in the twilight of the Clone Wars, released 2026-08-27 (RAWG lists no developer). RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result, "star-wars-zero-company" (id 1002691, released 2026-08-27), is the right game, but RAWG lists no developer or publisher, so the blurb names none. Its description names Hawks, a former Republic officer, and the twilight of the Clone Wars. No StrategyWiki page under "Star Wars Zero Company" or "Star Wars: Zero Company". starwars.fandom.com (Wookieepedia) answers the API under "Star Wars Zero Company", with at least 500 linked pages (the API's one-page limit; more remain, mostly credits), including "Assault of Luunata" and "Capture of Luunata"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Bruno" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2075800 as "STAR WARS Zero Company". 29 of 53 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the campaign chapter as a placeholder. Six hidden ones are named after people ("The Trooper", "The Umbaran", "The Prizefighter", "The Baroness", "The Mandalorian", "The Padawan") and may be tied to squad members, but their conditions are secret, so they were not moved. "Zero Company Legend" (all other achievements) sits in the campaign chapter.
